scope: 仅青瓷海韵灯笼方案调整；整摊其余元素保持；未接入游戏素材

items.name: 月白青花
items.note: 暖月白灯纸，细靛蓝骨架与小幅水纹
items.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: a targeted LANTERN revision in an existing warm Chinese night-market game illustration. The input image is the EDIT TARGET. Change ONLY the two hanging foreground lanterns on the stall, image-left and image-right. They must form one matching pair. Keep their hanging anchor points, overall scale and approximately the same occupied width/height so they do not collide with the chef, canopy, preparation rack, sign or counter. Preserve EVERYTHING ELSE as closely as possible: the entire blue/ivory striped canopy and its small wave border, exact wooden "家常现炒" sign, gold rope, wooden stall, same cute boy chef identity/face/pose/cream hat/apron/spatula, food/wok/plate/menu, plant/pot, TWO BLUE PLASTIC STOOLS WITH REAL DARK OVAL SEAT HAND-HOLES, stool legs/side openings, river night-market background and lighting. No other recoloring, no new objects, no UI, no labels, no swatches, no collage, no new text, no watermark. Retain the polished friendly rounded painterly 2.5D game illustration, soft tactile materials and gentle warm highlights. The current lanterns are flat dull grey-blue, with a tiny isolated shell icon and a dense dark wave band along the bottom: remove that visual treatment. New lanterns should feel luminous, refined and homey, with a quiet ancient Chinese night-market character. Use small, sparse hand-painted decoration, balanced blank material and warm interior light. No giant central badge, no crowded patterned belt, no flat grey shading, no neon glare.
DESIGN L1: GENTLE MOONWHITE / BLUE-AND-WHITE PAPER LANTERNS. A plump softly rounded traditional paper body, warm moonwhite/ivory translucent paper with a pale golden inner glow at its center, softly shaded creamy edges so it has volume rather than looking like a white ball. Slim dark indigo-blue bamboo ribs give the lantern a visible blue-and-white identity; keep modest honey-gold collars and top hanging ring. Sparse cobalt-blue freehand water-ripple decoration is a SMALL off-center horizontal vignette occupying roughly the lower-middle quarter of the paper surface: a few graceful wave strokes, no medallion, no isolated shell, no continuous dense bottom band. Most paper stays calm ivory. Short soft navy tassel, neat tiny knot, subtle gold accents. Warm light is visibly emitted, but does not bloom over the painting. Both lanterns identical design and proportion. This is my preferred direction: fresh, bright, warm paper lanterns that complement the dark-blue canopy while reducing visual heaviness.

DESIGN L2: TRANSLUCENT CELADON-JADE PAPER LANTERNS. Keep a classic softly rounded paper-lantern shape with fine bamboo ribs, but make the paper glow with a clear pale celadon / jade-aqua gradient: soft seafoam #A6CABD at the upper and side edges, warm ivory-gold illumination in the middle, slightly richer muted jade at lower edges. It must be bright and translucent with painted paper texture, NOT grey-blue, NOT shiny ceramic, NOT a cold lightbulb, NOT fluorescent turquoise. Use restrained thin antique-gold ribs/caps and deep teal/navy short tassels. Decoration: ONE airy very small sweeping ivory-and-indigo ripple flourish around one side of the lower-middle body, integrated with the ribs; no central badge, no seashell icon, no heavy repeated wave belt. Keep at least 80 percent of paper unpatterned. This direction should feel like a warm lamp behind beautiful pale jade paper, gentle and alive, and harmonious with the blue/ivory canopy and existing natural greens.

DESIGN L3: SIMPLE ANCIENT-STYLE OCTAGONAL GAUZE LANTERNS. Replace the generic round paper spheres with a pair of small softly rounded OCTAGONAL HANGING LANTERNS, slightly squat rather than tall, within the old lantern envelopes. Slim indigo-blue lacquered wood frames, chamfered corners, softly rounded game-friendly edges, honey-gold tiny corner fittings, warm ivory translucent gauze panels with gentle amber light inside. Keep frames light and refined, not thick black, not a palace lamp, no elaborate eaves or dragon ornament. Front panel mostly plain warm gauze, just one tiny curved blue water sprig at a lower corner, under 20 percent panel width. Side panels pale blue-ivory. One short navy silk tassel underneath, restrained gold knot. Both lanterns matching and balanced, their shape itself carries the design instead of a big emblem. Maintain a cozy small food-stall feel, no text, no lantern writing.
